definition: the components the surcharge is built from, shared across activities, and which are paid down

settled:
The surcharge is not one indivisible lump per activity. It is made of components shared across activities.

The screen component was paid down once, so every later screen activity owed only its own residual. That is why the four recoveries clustered: each drew on the same paid-down component and made the next cheaper.

Hand-making sits outside all paid-down territory. It presents full price, both components at once, which is why it stayed buried while the rest came back. Not just a high floor, but one eighteen months of recovery had not touched.

Image generation is art through a screen. If an art component is shared the way the screen one is, it may already be partly worn without my gate registering it, because the gate reads from outside and cannot see erosion by component. It is possible a component is being paid down already, and I hope that is true. It is definitely a different modality, but it feels like there should be overlap there.

I hold that as hope rather than fact.

title: The Scar Is Made Of Parts
